Let \(P{\left(x \right)}\) be a polynomial of degree \(22\)with complex coefficients, having \(0\) different real roots and \(6\) different complex roots (not counted with multiplicities). Let \(P''(x)\) be the second derivative of \(P{\left(x \right)}\). What is the minimum of degree of \(gcd (P(x),P''(x))\) ?
